title: Knip.NET configuration (knip.json)
description: Config-as-code for a Knip.NET run. All keys optional; defaults tuned for ASP.NET Core + xUnit/NUnit.

solution.description: Path to the .sln/.slnx/.csproj to analyze. CLI --solution overrides this.

production.description: Report production code that is reachable only through tests as onlyUsedByTests. Off by default; --production also enables it.

testProjects.description: Project-name globs that classify test projects before assembly and name-based detection.

entryPoints.description: Members the framework/runtime invokes without a by-name reference in your code.

attributes.description: Attribute identities. Built-ins use Assembly::Namespace.Type; namespace-qualified or simple configured values are explicit aliases. Attribute suffix optional.

treatAllPublicAsUsed.description: Treat the whole public surface as used (libraries consumed by other repos).

publicApiProjects.description: Project-name globs whose public API is treated as the used surface.

plugins.description: Built-in analysis plugins keyed by camelCase plugin id. Each block sets 'enabled' plus optional settings.

aliases.description: Explicit canonical framework type to local/user-extension type aliases. Keys and values are namespace-qualified type names; values may also use Assembly::Namespace.Type.
